svg.title: Time to first token
svg.desc: Both axes are logarithmic and equally scaled. The 45° diagonals are constant prefill speeds, so a curve's slope is how its time grows with the prompt (1: linear, 2: quadratic), and the vertical gap between two curves is a speed ratio.
